page.layout: One page of text, single column; large woodcut initial at the start of the first paragraph; faint show-through from the reverse page in the background (not transcribed); signature "A 2" at the foot.

main_text.head: DESIDERII PACII STRICTURÆ BREVES IN CL. D. FRIDERICI SPANHEMII. FIL. EPISTOLAM Ad AMICUM.
main_text.p: ON ita pridem in lucem prodiit Celeberrimi D. Spanhemii Epistola de novissimis circa res sacras in Belgio dissidiis, qua visa atque perlecta Obstupui steteruntque comæ, & vox faucibus hæsit.
Stupebam enim in innocentes & nihil tale meritos, omne jactari calumniarum genus, idque eo artificio, eaque callidi-tate, ut justus, ne incautos & rerum no-trarum ignaros seduceret, metus quem-libet

page.notes: The woodcut initial "N" is joined to "On" as printed ("ON"). Lines at the left edge are partly cut off in the scan (e.g. "tale", "genus", "tate", "trarum"), shown as printed; the first word of several lines is damaged and was read from context where not fully legible. Faint show-through from the facing page is ignored. Heading lines are transcribed as one head as they form one title.
